title: Small site kit: hub, guide, tool, privacy
what: One shared stylesheet and four pages for a free-tool and guide site: hub index with cards, guide article, tool page with input and result panels and a script mount, privacy page; the same header, nav and footer in all four.

slots.TITLE: Free pricing tools for small shops
slots.FOOT_NOTE: Free pricing calculators and plain guides for people who sell what they make.
slots.FOOT_FINE: © 2026 Pricewright. The numbers are estimates, not tax or legal advice.
slots.LEAD: Work out a fair price in a minute. Every tool runs in your browser, with no sign-up and nothing to install.
slots.FEATURED_TEXT: Enter what an item costs you and what you charge. See margin, markup and profit per sale.

slots.CARD_2_TEXT: How many sales cover your fixed costs each month.

slots.GUIDE_TITLE: How to price a handmade product
slots.GUIDE_LEAD: A four-step method that starts with what the item costs you and ends with a price you can say out loud.
slots.GUIDE_INTRO: Most makers pick a price by looking at the stall next door. That tells you what someone else charges, not what you need. Start from your own costs, then check the result against the market.
slots.STEP_1_TEXT: List everything that ends up in the finished item, down to thread and packaging. Use what you paid, not what you remember.
slots.STEP_2_TEXT: Pick an hourly rate you would accept from an employer. Multiply it by the hours one item takes, with finishing and packing.
slots.STEP_3_TEXT: Stall fees, tools, listing fees and waste. A flat 10 to 15 percent on top of materials and time is a fair start.
slots.STEP_4_TEXT: Multiply the total by two. That is the gap a shop needs if it ever stocks your work, and your own margin when you sell direct.
slots.CALLOUT_TITLE: Check the result against the shelf
slots.CALLOUT_TEXT: If your price lands far above similar items, look for hours to cut before you cut the rate. If it lands far below, raise it: cheap reads as low quality.
slots.TABLE_R3_C2: 12 percent of the two rows above
slots.TABLE_NOTE: Total cost $27.33. Doubled for retail it is $54.66, rounded to $55.
slots.CODE_TEXT: Paste this into any spreadsheet and replace the names with your own cells.
slots.CODE:
cost   = (materials + hours * rate) * (1 + overhead)
price  = cost * 2
margin = (price - cost) / price
slots.NEXT_TEXT: Put your cost and price into the margin calculator and see what each sale leaves you.
slots.TOOL_LEAD: Enter what one item costs you and what you sell it for. The result card shows what each sale leaves you.
slots.FIELD_2_HINT: What the buyer pays, before tax.
slots.FIELD_3_HINT: Leave it empty to skip the monthly total.
slots.RESULT_NOTE: of every sale is yours after costs
slots.HOW_1_TEXT: Profit divided by the selling price. It tells you what share of each sale you keep.
slots.HOW_2_TEXT: Profit divided by cost. The same profit always gives a bigger markup than margin.
slots.HOW_3_TEXT: Profit per item times the number you sell. Fixed costs such as rent are not included.
slots.TOOL_FAQ_1_A: No. The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you type leaves this page.
slots.TOOL_FAQ_2_A: Enter the price before sales tax or VAT. Tax you collect for the state is not your income.
slots.TOOL_FAQ_3_A: It depends on the trade. Many small makers aim for half the price or more when they sell direct.
slots.PRIVACY_INTRO: Pricewright is a set of calculators that run in your browser. This page says what we collect, which is very little, and why.
slots.POINT_3: Your numbers stay on your device
slots.PRIVACY_1_TEXT: Our server keeps a standard access log: the page you asked for, the time and a shortened IP address. We use it to count visits and to spot abuse.
slots.PRIVACY_2_TEXT: Anything you type into a calculator. The maths runs on your device and is not sent to us.
slots.PRIVACY_3_TEXT: We set no advertising or tracking cookies. One small setting may be stored in your browser to remember your currency.
slots.PRIVACY_4_TEXT: You can ask what we hold about you and ask us to delete it. Since we keep no accounts, there is usually nothing to find.
slots.PRIVACY_CONTACT_TEXT: Questions about this page? Write to privacy@pricewright.example.
